thread:
mike: quick incident: a recent export map refactor caused failures in our JS SDK when used in edge/CDN contexts. Local node tests passed so this landed unnoticed.
anya: can you paste the failing pattern?
mike: users doing `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` or `require('redwood-sdk')` in starter apps see ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND in Vercel/Cloudflare builds. Deno + Bun CI also reported resolution errors when using npm: specifiers.
lee: that sounds like we removed the package root (.) from the exports map and only kept internal subpaths. many sample apps import the root.
sarah: yep. current built package had "exports": {"./client":"./dist/esm/client.js","./server":"./dist/cjs/server.js"} only. No root, no ./package.json, no types pointer.
mike: consequence: edge runtimes and some bundlers can't infer a default entrypoint. Also TypeScript consumers hit "Could not find declaration file for module 'redwood-sdk'".
anya: shortlist of fixes?
lee: immediate patch: add a root entry that specifies import/require/types, expose ./package.json, and add a wildcard `./*` to map subpaths if needed. Example: "exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js","types":"./dist/types/index.d.ts"},"./*":"./dist/*","./package.json":"./package.json"}.
sarah: also restore `main` and `module` fields for older tools that still look at them.
mike: operational plan: (1) open packaging PR with exports + types + main/module; (2) publish canary to staging npm registry; (3) run sample-apps CI matrix (node/bun/deno/edge) against staging; (4) if green, release patch. publish-bot: adding checklist entry.
anya: add tests to prevent regressions: a small resolver smoke test that runs in Miniflare/wrangler for edge, `deno bundle` for deno, and `bun build` for bun. Keep tests lightweight (smoke-only).
lee: long term: add a packaging validator script in prepublish that asserts exports contains `.` and `./package.json` and that the `types` entry exists and points to a file. Fail publish if missing.
sarah: also update sample-apps to prefer explicit subpath imports (e.g., `redwood-sdk/client`) where appropriate and add guidance in the SDK docs about stable public surface.
mike: one gotcha: some edge bundlers ignore `require` targets and always use import resolution; ensure ESM bundle has no CJS artifacts and uses consistent `.js`/`.mjs` extensions as required.
anya: I'll add a lint rule in the monorepo that warns when a PR modifies `exports` without a changelog entry and a compatibility note.
lee: will open the PR and include a minimal repro (Cloudflare worker script) so reviewers can validate. Ping me if you want to run local Miniflare repro.
sarah: thanks. I'll follow up to add types packaging verification to the build. publish-bot: ACTION: create canary publish step; run sample-apps matrix; run packaging validator.
mike: target to ship patch today. tagging @eng-runtime and @devex for visibility.
